Quiet описує самого пса (який?), а loudl: Quiet describes the dog itself (what kind?), while loudly describes how he barks (how?). Always and never go before the verb.
Хом’як, коробка і мій черевик: A hamster, a box and my shoe
A hamster, коли згадуємо вперше. The ham: A hamster when we mention it for the first time. The hamster, the box when we both already know which one.
Had it cut, having it fixed: роботу роби: Had it cut, having it fixed: someone else does the job, not Ben. The pattern is have + object + V3.
Найрозумніший телефон у домі: The smartest phone in the house
Faster than, older than: порівнюємо двох: Faster than, older than: comparing two things. The smartest: the best of the whole group, always with the.
План Лео: грати за будь-яких умов: Leo’s plan: play no matter what
If + Present, will: реальний план (перши: If + Present, will: a real plan (first conditional). If I were ..., I’d: an imaginary situation (second conditional).
Пожежна сигналізація теж фанатка: The smoke alarm is a fan too
Crazy about, worry about, depend on: при: Crazy about, worry about, depend on: the preposition comes paired with the word, and you just have to learn the pair.
Going to: план, вирішений заздалегідь. I: Going to: a plan decided in advance. I’ll start: a decision made right now, on seeing the rain.
Після when і as soon as про майбутнє ста: After when and as soon as we use the Present for the future (ends, you’re), and will only in the main clause.
Decide and manage are followed by to + V. Stop, avoid and keep want -ing.
I’ve got означає «у мене є». Для she/he/: I’ve got means “I have”. For she/he/it it is has got, and in questions Have you got? / Has she got?
Пес, який знає одне слово: A dog who knows one word
Sit! і Don’t eat!: наказ без підмета. Le: Sit! and Don’t eat!: an order with no subject. Let’s go: suggesting doing something together.
Want + to + V (хочу щось зробити). Like,: Want + to + V (I want to do something). Like, love, enjoy + -ing (what I like doing).
Despite + іменник, although + ціле речен: Despite + noun, although + a full clause, however starts a new sentence. In case: just in case.
Might, could, may + V: ми не впевнені, ц: Might, could, may + V: we are not sure, it is only a possibility.
Світ почекає, математика ні: The world can wait, maths can’t
Can I ...? просить дозволу, have to і mu: Can I ...? asks for permission, have to and must are about obligation, should gives advice.
Детектив і шоколадний ніс: The detective and the chocolate nose
Must be: впевнені, що так. Can’t be: впе: Must be: we are sure it is true. Can’t be: we are sure it is not. Might be: possible, but not certain.
Was eaten, was taken, was left: пасив. В: Was eaten, was taken, was left: the passive. What matters is what happened to the homework, not who is to blame.
Розслідування повільного Wi-Fi: The case of the slow Wi-Fi
Is being fixed: процес саме зараз, has b: Is being fixed: a process happening right now, has been unplugged: a result up to now. It is said that: “people say that”.
Персонаж теж робив домашку: The game character did homework too
Was/were + -ing: дія в процесі в конкрет: Was/were + -ing: an action in progress at a specific moment in the past (at nine last night).
Піца зникла, свідок спить: The pizza vanished, the witness is asleep
Had disappeared, had fallen asleep: це с: Had disappeared, had fallen asleep: this happened even earlier than another moment in the past (got, asked).
Cleaned з -ed, а put і went неправильні: Cleaned takes -ed, while put and went are irregular verbs. Questions are built with did: What did you do?
Have you ever been: досвід без точного ч: Have you ever been: experience with no exact time. Last summer names a specific time, so went and saw.
Я не їм, я доглядаю: I’m not eating it, I’m looking after it
Give up (кинути), wake up (прокинутися),: Give up (quit), wake up, pick up, look after (take care of): the particle completely changes the meaning of the verb.
Скільки сиру? Багато, Біскіт допомагає: How much cheese? A lot, Biscuit is helping
Potatoes і tomatoes: після -o додаємо -e: Potatoes and tomatoes: after -o we add -es. Cheese is uncountable, so how much and some, with no -s.
Dad’s, Biscuit’s: один власник, додаємо: Dad’s, Biscuit’s: one owner, add ’s. Parents’: several owners and the word already ends in -s, so just an apostrophe.
On: на поверхні, under: під, in: всереди: On: on a surface, under: below, in: inside. The cat picks the most important spot.
